title: Oklahoma Edges West Virginia 50-49 in a 2012 Shootout
question: What was the score of Oklahoma vs West Virginia on November 17, 2012?
answer: Oklahoma won 50-49 at West Virginia on November 17, 2012. Landry Jones threw for 554 yards and six touchdowns, including the late go-ahead score to Kenny Stills.
summary: On November 17, 2012, Landry Jones threw six touchdowns and 554 yards as Oklahoma outlasted West Virginia 50-49 in Morgantown. Here is how it played out.
body: On November 17, 2012, the Sooners traveled to Morgantown for a Big 12 game that turned into one of the wildest scoring duels of the season. Oklahoma left with a 50-49 victory, and not a lot of defense was played along the way.

Sooner quarterback Landry Jones had a career afternoon, completing 38 of 51 passes for 554 yards and six touchdowns. The decisive moment came late in the fourth quarter, when he found receiver Kenny Stills in the end zone to put Oklahoma ahead. Oklahoma missed the two-point try, so the lead was only a single point, and the Sooners needed one more stop.

West Virginia had plenty of firepower of its own. Quarterback Geno Smith threw four touchdown passes, all of them caught by Stedman Bailey, who finished with more than 200 receiving yards. Tavon Austin ran for 344 yards, a huge number against an Oklahoma defense that rarely allowed that kind of production. The Mountaineers had the ball in hand for a last chance, but Oklahoma came up with an interception on a final desperation heave to end it.

The win moved the Sooners to 8-2 and kept their Big 12 title hopes alive. For West Virginia, it was another close loss in a season in which its offense put up big numbers but the team struggled to finish games. Fans who were watching still talk about it as a game where nobody felt safe until the final snap.
